payload.evidence: cc enumerated every gate CI runs and drove all seven: cargo test debug 12+133, cargo test --release 12+133 (CI's actual arm), clippy --all-targets -D warnings 0, cargo build --release clean, shellcheck 18 files, utilz test prez all 4 suites, devbin check autotests 2 crates. The row caught its own author twice on the day it was minted -- cc called WP-01 green on cargo test alone, and vc called it verified on clippy plus cargo build, two gates of four.
